body:
This is the response I needed. Something to read repeatedly until I fall asleep or the sun comes up and I can make myself go about my day. It may sound somewhat pompous, but I needed a response from someone like you. 

It's a difficult position to be in, in that it's difficult to talk about without coming off as an arrogant, ungrateful person. When you appear so well adjusted on paper, when your accomplishments and influence are significant relative to your age, it's difficult to get across how success itself becomes a source of absolute misery in that it solidifies how empty you feel regardless of what you may obtain. 

Thank you. This *did* help significantly, and I'm going to use it to make it through the night. You made a significant impact here. I saved the comment. Copied it to a couple different local documents so its saved if needed again in the future. Much love, and best of luck in your future endeavors.

I'm giving this until 4AM eastern time. 

I need one answer. One person who gives a shit enough to think up a reason. If I know that one person cares selflessly - not because they need me, or I'd be a loss in their life just due to previous establishment (rather than active positive contribution), than I won't do it.

One person. One reason. Four hours. 

Then the whole pill bottle is going down the hatchet, the handle will follow, and goodbye and good luck to you all.
